Who We Are

About
IKON INFRA

Ikon Infra is a next-generation infrastructure company founded by a team of IIM and IIT graduates with a vision to transform infrastructure execution through AI-enabled planning and data-backed decision making.

The company is focused on delivering high-quality infrastructure projects with efficiency, precision, and modern project management practices. By integrating technology, analytics, and execution excellence, Ikon Infra aims to redefine the standards of construction and infrastructure development in India.

Currently, the company is executing various Civil Infrastructure projects with government departments across defence, railway, and residential infrastructure sectors.
